name: Texas

flag.description: A blue vertical band at the hoist with a white five-pointed star, beside two equal horizontal stripes of white over red.
flag.symbolism: State law says blue stands for loyalty, white for purity and red for bravery, and the single star gives the Lone Star State its name.

hook: Texas runs its blue band the full height of the flag; Chile squeezes its star into a small blue square in the corner.
trivia: The flag was adopted in 1839 as the national flag of the Republic of Texas and kept when Texas joined the Union in 1845.
Chile's similar flag dates from 1817, more than twenty years before Texas's.
